description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for open India defence tenders — "open Indian Army tenders", "Indian Navy procurement", "IAF tenders closing this month", "DRDO tenders", "MES works tenders in Jaisalmer", "Ministry of Defence RFPs". Lists ACTIVE Government of India defence procurement tenders from the official Ministry of Defence e-Procurement portal (defproc.gov.in: Army, Navy, Air Force, DRDO, Military Engineer Services, Border Roads Organisation, Defence Estates, Coast Guard, Integrated Defence Staff), plus defence PSUs on the central PSU portal (AWEIL, Armoured Vehicles Nigam, Munitions India, Yantra India, India Optel, Troop Comforts, shipyards) and DRDO / Defence Estates on the CPPP central portal. Optional keyword and organisation filters. Each tender has tender ID, reference number, title, organisation chain, published / bid-closing / bid-opening dates (IST), and the source portal. Also reports which organisations were scanned and their live active-tender counts.

closing_after.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: only tenders whose bid submission closes on or after this date.

include_large_orgs.description: Also scan Military Engineer Services (~4,000 active works tenders on one slow page, 30-60 s). Default false; naming it in organisation also includes it.

include_psus.description: Also scan defence PSUs and MoD bodies on the central portals (default true).

limit.description: Max tenders to return (default 25, max 100). Newest published first.

organisation.description: Optional organisation substring, e.g. "Air Force", "Navy", "Army", "Research and Development" (DRDO), "Military Engineer" (MES), "Border Roads", "Munitions". Omit to scan every defence organisation.

query.description: Optional keywords (all must match, case-insensitive) against title, reference number, tender ID and organisation chain, e.g. "generator", "radar", "jaisalmer".

name: india_defence_tenders
title: India Defence Tenders
